title: Reading Habit Coach – Book Tracker
shortDescription: Track books, reading time and pages. Keep a private journal and build consistency with flexible weekly goals. No account needed.
intro: Read more consistently. Remember what matters.
library: Reading Habit Coach gives your books, reading moments and ideas a calm, private home. Organise physical books, audiobooks, library ebooks and compatible personal documents. Keep shelves, tags, progress and personal ratings.
sessions: Start, pause and finish a reading session, or log reading you have already done. Record minutes and page progress. Audiobook time is never converted into invented page counts.
goals: Choose daily reading minutes and weekly reading days. Confirmed consistency is based on completed weeks, leaving room for days off. Your reading history stays with you.
journal: Save ideas, quotes, questions and reflections in a searchable journal. Link notes to books, add tags and favourites, and export your notes.
reader: Read compatible personal PDFs and DRM-free EPUBs. EPUB controls include type size, spacing, themes, chapters, bookmarks, saved positions, text search and selected-text or chapter read-aloud. PDF viewing includes pages, zoom and bookmarks. PDF text search, OCR, text highlights and PDF read-aloud are unavailable. Protected Kindle books and Kindle library integration are unsupported.
voice: Use localized example commands through touch or text. Speech recognition and offline read-aloud depend on installed system services. Recognition may need the internet. Your books and notes are never automatically translated.
privacy: No account or ads. Books, sessions and notes are stored locally. Optional metadata search sends your query to Open Library. Export JSON records, session CSV or journal notes. Optional passphrase-protected local backups are available; imported document files are excluded.
preview: Early-access build. Premium checkout and cloud backup are not configured. No in-app charges are taken. Requires Android API 26 or later. Translations are included; native-speaker review remains pending. Device voice capabilities vary.
bullet1: Organise your books with private shelves, progress, tags and personal ratings.
bullet2: Track reading sessions and manual logs with measured time and page progress.
bullet3: Build a routine with daily minute and flexible weekly reading-day goals.
bullet4: Keep searchable ideas, quotes and reflections linked to your books.
bullet5: Read supported personal documents and export private reading records.
keywords: reading tracker, book tracker, reading journal, book notes, reading timer, reading goals, EPUB reader
